Terms

Updated 1 October 2026

Using BloxBob SMP

Play fairly and follow staff instructions and the applicable Minecraft rules. Staff may moderate accounts to protect the server and other players. BloxBob SMP is an independent community server and is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.

Ranks

Rank prices shown on the Store page are proposed monthly subscription prices. Purchases are currently unavailable. Before subscriptions go live, the checkout will show the current price, renewal and cancellation terms. Rank cosmetics, Discord roles and community events depend on those services being available; video casting is opt-in and never guarantees a role.

Giveaways

Community giveaways, if held, are open to everyone under the rules announced for each event. A paid rank does not increase giveaway odds.

Questions

Contact BloxBob SMP staff in game before purchasing if you have questions about a rank.
